acceptance_criteria:
- Dry run reports what would be removed
- Aggregates are preserved after raw rows are removed
- Running in production before the first class reaches classes.ended_at + RETENTION_MONTHS (jade-8n2.1)
- Tiered at classes.ended_at + RETENTION_MONTHS (jade-8n2.8): events reduced to step_aggregates (no kit id); kit_progress and device_sessions deleted; facilitator_notes kept with kit_id set to null; quiz_responses and exit_cards reduced to per-question / per-module counts with no kit id, then deleted
- step_aggregates and the quiz/exit-card aggregate tables are defined in a migration and documented in the data model
description:
Scheduled job that, after the configured period, replaces raw events with per-step aggregates. Period comes from config (default 12 months after class end, to be confirmed against the research approval). Supports dry run.

Plan key: p9-retention. Phase file: docs/handoff/phases/phase-09-privacy-security-hardening.md
title: Retention job
